description: The land "between the rivers" Tigris and Euphrates, home to the earliest post-flood civilizations of Genesis 10-11 and, in a broader sense, the wider region Abraham's family originally came from before settling in Haran (Acts 7:2).
family_friendly_summary: Mesopotamia means "the land between the rivers" — the Tigris and the Euphrates. The earliest cities after the flood were built there, including Babel, and it is the wider region Abraham's family originally came from before God called him to Canaan.
